Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryBinaryBlendEnvelope

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryBinaryBlendEnvelope
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryBinaryBlendEnvelope extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable feasible mass-fraction envelope for a quality-constrained binary refinery blend.

The envelope combines the existing ideal-additive-volume specific-gravity rule, linear sulfur/nitrogen bookkeeping, and common-temperature Refutas kinematic-viscosity rule. It does not mutate an assay or thermodynamic system and does not introduce an independent property correlation.

  • Method Details

    • fromQualityConstraints

      public static RefineryBinaryBlendEnvelope fromQualityConstraints(double[] sourceSpecificGravities, double[] sourceSulfurMassFractions, double[] sourceNitrogenMassFractions, double[] sourceKinematicViscositiesCSt, double temperatureCelsius, double minimumApiGravity, double maximumApiGravity, double maximumSulfurMassFraction, double maximumNitrogenMassFraction, double minimumKinematicViscosityCSt, double maximumKinematicViscosityCSt)
      Build the feasible binary mass-fraction interval for explicit product-quality limits.
      Parameters:
      sourceSpecificGravities - two source specific gravities
      sourceSulfurMassFractions - two total-sulfur mass fractions on a 0-1 basis
      sourceNitrogenMassFractions - two total-nitrogen mass fractions on a 0-1 basis
      sourceKinematicViscositiesCSt - two source viscosities in cSt at the common temperature
      temperatureCelsius - common source-viscosity temperature in degrees Celsius
      minimumApiGravity - inclusive minimum blend API gravity
      maximumApiGravity - inclusive maximum blend API gravity
      maximumSulfurMassFraction - inclusive maximum blend sulfur mass fraction
      maximumNitrogenMassFraction - inclusive maximum blend nitrogen mass fraction
      minimumKinematicViscosityCSt - inclusive minimum blend viscosity in cSt
      maximumKinematicViscosityCSt - inclusive maximum blend viscosity in cSt
      Returns:
      immutable feasible binary envelope
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for invalid sources, bounds, or an empty feasible interval

    • planMinimumCost

      public RefineryBinaryBlendEnvelope.Plan planMinimumCost(double firstSourceCostPerMass, double secondSourceCostPerMass)
      Select the unique minimum-cost endpoint of the feasible interval.

      Costs may use any common currency per common mass unit. Equal costs fail closed when the feasible interval contains more than one point because the optimum is then non-unique.

      Parameters:
      firstSourceCostPerMass - non-negative first-source unit cost
      secondSourceCostPerMass - non-negative second-source unit cost
      Returns:
      immutable minimum-cost combined property plan
